title: Pan-Seared Norwegian Salmon with Biryani Spices
description: A flavorful, keto-friendly dish that combines the richness of salmon with the aromatic spices of biryani. Pan-searing the salmon ensures a crispy crust and a tender interior.

ingredients.name: Biryani Spices
ingredients.notes: Mix of cinnamon, cardamom, and cumin

instructions: Season the salmon fillets with kissed salt and biryani spices.
Heat the ghee or avocado oil in an oven-safe skillet over medium-high heat.
Sear the salmon fillets for 2-3 minutes on each side, or until browned.
Transfer the skillet to the preheated oven and bake for 8-10 minutes, or until the salmon reaches an internal temperature of 145°F (63°C).
Remove the skillet from the oven and let the salmon rest for 2-3 minutes.
Serve the salmon with silky lettuce leaves and garnish with chopped cilantro, if desired.
